name: lease-release

test: test/unit/accountRequestLease.test.ts — releases an abandoned paid-helper stream with no settlement left open
failingAssertion: expected 1 to be +0 (live lease after abandonment)

name: retry-own-block

mutation: retry vendorLimit skip removed (`const blocking = triggers`)
test: test/unit/accountRequestLease.test.ts — forwards a paid-helper 429 to the lease rate limit with its reset time; retries an image 429 as a new send on the same lease

name: stop-ends-wait
finding: P2-1 (ModelApiHost.ts): the in-lease image spending question keeps Stop
test: test/unit/accountLeaseProduction.test.ts — ends a waiting image spending question on Stop and releases its lease

failingAssertion: expected false to be true (turn unfinished 2s after Stop); expected 1 to be +0 (lease leaked)
